benefit: Preventive Oral Health Services in Primary Care
source: PhilHealth Tamang Sagot, Circular No. 2024-0034 (philhealth.gov.ph, fetched 2026-10-29)
year_note: inferred: the circular says 'sa loob ng isang taon' and does not say calendar or rolling

eligibility.reason: The patient must first register with a PhilHealth-accredited Konsulta Package Provider.

tooth_caps.reason: Pit and fissure sealant or root surface protection: no more than two teeth in one year.

conditional_services.reason: Tooth extraction is covered only when the patient has severe tooth pain treated as an emergency.

codes_note: inferred: the circular's table has codes for a 1st and 2nd visit only, and no code for the extraction
